Eligibility Criteria
Exchange KYC-verified users
received ARKM directly in their accounts.
Platform VIP Referrers
had to log in to the website and manually claim their tokens.
The primary allocation method was
trading on the Arkham Exchange
, where users earned points based on their trading activity.
Points were also
earned through referrals
—inviting others to the platform contributed to a user’s total allocation.
Many countries were
not eligible
for trading on the platform, limiting participation in the airdrop.
